subject: general
question: The marked price of an iPad is ₹960. It is sold with two successive discounts of 25% each, followed by an additional 15% discount for cash payment. What is the final selling price (in ₹) after the cash discount?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The final Selling Price (SP) after successive discounts can be found directly using multiplying factors.

A 25% discount means the item is sold at 75% or 3/4 of its price.

A 15% discount means the item is sold at 85% or 17/20 of its price.

Final SP = 960 × (3/4) × (3/4) × (17/20)

Final SP = 960 × (153/320) = 3 × 153 = 459

**∴ The correct answer is ₹459.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Marked Price (MP) of the iPad = ₹960

Successive discounts: D₁ = 25%, D₂ = 25%, D₃ = 15%

**Formula Used:**

Final Selling Price (SP) = MP × (1 − D₁/100) × (1 − D₂/100) × (1 − D₃/100)

 
 Successive Discount Flow 
• -25% 
• -25% 
• -15% ₹960 MP ₹720 Price 1 ₹540 Price 2 ₹459 Final SP 

**Calculations:**

⇒ SP = 960 × (1 − 25/100) × (1 − 25/100) × (1 − 15/100)

⇒ SP = 960 × (75/100) × (75/100) × (85/100)

⇒ SP = 960 × (3/4) × (3/4) × (17/20)

⇒ SP = 960 × (153/320)

⇒ SP = 3 × 153 = 459

**∴ The correct answer is ₹459.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Effective Equivalent Discount

For two successive discounts of a% and b%, the single equivalent discount is calculated using the formula: Equivalent Discount = (a + b − ab/100)%.

Marked Price vs Cost Price

Discounts are always calculated on the Marked Price (MP) of the article. Meanwhile, Profit or Loss percentages are calculated on the Cost Price (CP).

Successive Percentage Change

Applying successive discounts of x%, y%, and z% is the same as finding the successive decrease of a value, meaning the order of discounts does not change the final selling price.
